text_block_list.text:
Can you hear it, the tolling of the new

generation's bell? Can you see it, the
glimpse of
my evolution into the
Centurial Overlord? I feel
both with my
very soul.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Only I, the strongest, am worthy of
inheriting the
history that the Golden
Generation carved with
their cleats.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Thus, my next objective is where only
the truly
strong fight—the spring Tenno
Sho!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
